dimensions: M=1/4/8/16, N=8, K=64; signed INT8 × INT8 -> signed INT64 accumulation

memory.implementation: ai_spad_arbiter + ai_scratchpad four-bank VCS behavioral RAM
memory.read_latency: two registered scratchpad stages plus arbiter response tagging
memory.input_layout: dense row-major INT8 bytes in SPAD, unpacked into kernel MAX_K/MAX_N local-buffer strides

stress.contention: continuous DMA reads through the production arbiter; same-bank and rotating-bank address patterns
stress.abort: during input-read, kernel-compute, and result-writeback phases
stress.reset: asserted with an accepted core read awaiting its response; verifies no stale writeback
stress.checker: independent INT32 GEMM plus complete SPAD result-image and uncommitted sentinel checks

timing_limit: research wrapper measures real arbiter/SPAD and kernel RTL; it is not connected to the production Matrix command path and is not an ASIC PPA result
